title: MATLAB Implementation and Input Data for: Comparative Assessment of ELCC, ECP, and Firm Capacity Methodologies for Resource Adequacy in Renewable-Dominated Power Systems (IEEE ETCM 2026, Paper ID 119)
description: MATLAB implementation and input datasets supporting the paper presented at the 2026 IEEE Eighth Ecuador Technical Chapters Meeting (ETCM 2026). The repository contains a unified probabilistic-deterministic framework based on exact recursive Capacity Outage Probability Table (COPT) convolution and 8760-hour chronological Loss of Load Expectation (LOLE) evaluation. Three capacity credit metrics are systematically compared: Effective Load Carrying Capability (ELCC), Equivalent Conventional Power (ECP), and Firm Capacity (PEPP criterion). The framework is validated on a 24-hour illustrative case and on the Ecuador National Interconnected System (SNI) 2025, using a disaggregated 19-unit generation model and a real solar profile derived from 13,017 spatially distributed NSRDB measurement points.
